items.html: And likewise, in this manner it was in the particular of the particular, for the ten Sefirot themselves in each and every Partzuf: at first the most praiseworthy was sorted for its Sefira of Keter, and afterward the more inferior for its Sefira of Hochma, etc. And likewise, in this manner, the ten Sefirot included in each and every Sefira. And there is no need to elaborate on this, for the power of the pen failed to detail all the particulars.
